scenes.text: Imagine standing in a specific fifty-square-mile strip of wild forest land where you could theoretically commit the perfect crime and walk away completely free.
This isn't a movie, but a very real place inside Yellowstone National Park known as the Zone of Death where a bizarre constitutional loophole actually exists.

Since the United States Constitution requires a jury from the exact state and district where the crime occurred, and absolutely zero people live in this completely uninhabited Idaho sliver, forming a legal jury is physically impossible.

Congress has known about this terrifying legal loophole for over fifteen years but has done nothing to fix it, so would you ever dare to camp alone in this lawless place, and make sure to hit follow for more mind-blowing legal facts.
